Noon. Qalam aur us cheez ki qasam jo ye likh rahe hain
Aap apne Parwardigar ki ne'mat ke tufail majnoon nahin hain
Aur aap ke liye kabhi na khatm hone waala ajr hai
Aur aap buland-tareen akhlaaq ke darje par hain
Anqareeb aap bhi dekhenge aur woh bhi dekh lenge
Ke deewaana kaun hai
Aap ka Parwardigar behtar jaanta hai ke kaun us ke raaste se behak gaya hai aur kaun hidaayat-yaafta hai
Lehaaza aap jhutlaane waalon ki itaa'at na karein
Ye chaahte hain ke aap zara narm ho jaayen to ye bhi narm ho jaayen
Aur khabardaar, aap kisi bhi musalsal qasam khaane waale zaleel
Aib-joo aur aala darje ke chughalkhor
Maal mein be-had bukhl karne waale, tajaawuz-kaar gunaahgaar
Bad-mizaaj aur is ke baad bad-nasl ki itaa'at na karein
Sirf is baat par ke ye saahib-e-maal o aulaad hai
Jab is ke saamne aayaat-e-Ilaahiya ki tilaawat ki jaati hai to keh deta hai ke ye sab agle logon ki daastaanein hain
Hum anqareeb is ki naak par nishaan laga denge
Hum ne un ko isi tarah aazmaaya hai jis tarah baagh waalon ko aazmaaya tha, jab unhon ne qasam khaai thi ke subah ko phal tod lenge
Aur insha'Allah nahin kahenge
To Khuda ki taraf se raaton raat ek bala ne chakkar lagaaya jab ye sab so rahe the
Aur saara baagh jal kar kaali raat jaisa ho gaya
Phir subah ko ek ne doosre ko aawaaz di
Ke phal todna hai to apne apne khet ki taraf chalo
Phir sab gaye is aalam mein ke aapas mein raazdaaraana baatein kar rahe the
Ke khabardaar aaj baagh mein koi miskeen daakhil na hone paaye
Aur rok-thaam ka bandobast kar ke subah sawere pahunch gaye
Ab jo baagh ko dekha to kehne lage ke hum to behak gaye
Balke bilkul se mehroom ho gaye
To un ke munsif-mizaaj ne kaha ke main ne na kaha tha ke tum log tasbeeh-e-Parwardigar kyun nahin karte
Kehne lage ke hamaara Rabb paak o be-niyaaz hai aur hum waaqai zaalim the
Phir ek ne doosre ko malaamat karna shuru kar di
Kehne lage ke afsos, hum bilkul sarkash the
Shaayad hamaara Parwardigar humein is se behtar de de, ke hum us ki taraf raghbat karne waale hain
Isi tarah azaab naazil hota hai, aur aakhirat ka azaab to is se bada hai agar unhein ilm ho
Be-shak saahibaan-e-taqwa ke liye Parwardigar ke yahaan ne'maton ki jannat hai
Kya hum itaa'at-guzaaron ko mujrimon jaisa bana dein
Tumhein kya ho gaya hai, kaisa faisla kar rahe ho
Ya tumhaari koi kitaab hai jis mein ye sab padha karte ho
Ke wahaan tumhaari pasand ki saari cheezein haazir milengi
Ya tum ne hum se roz-e-Qiyaamat tak ki qasmein le rakhi hain ke tumhein woh sab kuchh milega jis ka tum faisla karoge
In se poochhiye ke in sab baaton ka zimmedaar kaun hai
Ya in ke liye shuraka hain? To agar ye sachche hain to apne shuraka ko le aayen
Jis din pindli khol di jaaegi aur inhein sajdon ki daawat di jaaegi aur ye sajda bhi na kar sakenge
In ki nigaahein sharm se jhuki hongi, zillat in par chhaai hogi, aur inhein us waqt bhi sajdon ki daawat di ja rahi thi jab ye bilkul saheeh o saalim the
To ab mujhe aur is baat ke jhutlaane waalon ko chhod do, hum anqareeb inhein is tarah giraftaar karenge ke inhein andaaza bhi na hoga
Aur hum to is liye dheel de rahe hain ke hamaari tadbeer mazboot hai
Kya aap in se mazdoori maang rahe hain jo ye us ke taawaan ke bojh se dabe ja rahe hain
Ya in ke paas koi ghaib hai jise ye likh rahe hain
Ab aap apne Parwardigar ke hukm ke liye sabr karein aur Saahib-e-Hoot jaise na ho jaayen, jab unhon ne nihaayat ghusse ke aalam mein aawaaz di thi
Ke agar unhein ne'mat-e-Parwardigar ne sambhaal na liya hota to unhein chateel maidaan mein bure haalon mein chhod diya jaata
Phir un ke Rabb ne unhein muntakhab kar ke nek kirdaaron mein qaraar de diya
Aur ye kuffaar Qur'an ko sunte hain to aisa lagta hai ke anqareeb aap ko nazron se phisla denge, aur ye kehte hain ke ye to deewaane hain
Halaanke ye Qur'an aalameen ke liye naseehat hai aur bas
